Publish.LongDescription:
# Sign Builder **Design, edit, and build road signs in game and put them on your roads.**
## Features - Sign designer - Gantry editor - Place signs on gantries, posts, or any surface - Themes: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, China, Switzerland, Germany, France, Italy, Japan, Nordic, and Russia.
## Designer - Live, to-scale preview with templates for multiple countries. - Parts: text, route shields, arrows, lane diagrams (exits, forks, roundabouts), LED text, dividers, exit tabs, and more. - LED message boards with dot-matrix lettering that glows at night - Fonts, colors, and spacing from each country's sign style; save your own templates
## Placement - Place gantries across roads: double or single truss, curved or straight tube, span or cantilever, signs on both sides - Arrange signs over lanes and add lights - Roadside signs on posts, or the sign as a prop on any surface - Edit placed signs and gantries
## Sharing - Placed signs are normal objects saved with your city; the city rebuilds them on any PC with Sign Builder. - Themes are plain files: make your own, or publish theme packs on Paradox Mods (template included on GitHub) - Safe: The mod can be removed without any save corruption, signs will remain as unrendered gray blobs you can delete.
# How to Use 1. Click the Sign Builder button in the top-left toolbar. 2. Pick a template from the library, or start from scratch. Click a part in the preview to edit it, or use Add part to add text, route shields, arrows, lane diagrams and more. 3. Choose how to place the sign: - **Gantry**: click a road to place a gantry across it. Click other roads alongside to widen the span, add more signs, move them over lanes, set the height and the posts' distance from the road, then click Build. - **Roadside**: a sign on posts beside the road. Rotate it with right-drag, raise or lower it with Ctrl + mouse wheel, and move it closer to or farther from the road with Alt + mouse wheel. - **Prop**: just the sign, on any surface or the side of an elevated road. 4. To change a placed sign or gantry, click it and choose Edit, Move or Duplicate.
## Tips - Hold Shift for bigger steps or Ctrl for finer steps on the nudge buttons. - Save your own designs to the template library to reuse them. - Turn on Lights to add a light below each sign; it switches on at dusk.
